snippet.text: theorem exists_radial_derivative_bound … (FL : EdgeFactor K c (leftChart a T)) (FR : EdgeFactor K 4 (rightChart b T)) (n : ℕ) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ X ∈ Ioo (Real.exp a) (Real.exp b), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (radialPullback T) (p,X)‖ ≤ C * radialWeight c a b X / edgeDistance a b (Real.log X)^N  -- docstring: "The same weight controls genuine derivatives in `X`, not just in `log X`."
